selectionNote: Selected 12 guided Venice d522 products with live USD From$ prices, ratings, and unique 674x446 heroes. The live catalog supports far more than 20 tours, but Viator DataDome blocking plus geo-currency dumps (EUR/CAD/GBP/CHF/AUD/SEK) blocked many otherwise-strong SKUs from being verified in USD. Jeep/off-road and stargazing SKUs were not captured as active USD product pages. Helicopter 408100P25 had no complete USD rating/hero dump. Did not force inactive similar-options pages, non-USD pages, near-duplicates, audio/self-guided SKUs, 4.4 ratings, or products with unusable heroes.
